title: Heat Exchangers
summary: Custom shell-and-tube heat exchangers, condensers, coolers and reboilers for specified process duties and mechanical design conditions.
body:
Tongyang manufactures custom heat-transfer equipment for process heating, cooling, condensing and vaporization duties. Equipment geometry, materials and maintainability are reviewed together with the client's thermal and hydraulic requirements.

Typical applications

  • Shell-and-tube process coolers and heaters
  • Overhead and surface condensers
  • Column reboilers and related thermal equipment
  • Plant utility and process heat recovery services

Key technical parameters for quotation

  • Both streams: composition, phase, mass/volumetric flow and fouling characteristics
  • Thermal duty: inlet/outlet temperatures, target heat load or required approach temperature
  • Hydraulics: operating/design pressures, temperatures and allowable pressure drop for each side
  • Mechanical: shell/tube material, corrosion allowance, tube dimensions and preferred exchanger configuration
  • Project: utilities, plot/maintenance space, connection data, inspection and required documents

Engineering & standards

Mechanical fabrication and inspection can be evaluated against the specified pressure-equipment code. TEMA requirements may be considered for exchanger construction when requested. Thermal sizing, detailed thermal-hydraulic calculations and performance guarantees require a defined design responsibility and confirmed process data.

Quotation basis: provide duty sheets and available PFD/P&ID, GA or mechanical specification. Final exchanger dimensions, pressure drops and testing scope are confirmed during engineering review.
